about_the_game:
THE EARTH's BEEN BLOWN TO SMITHEREENS...

It's been three years after 'The Missile War' - the global conflict between the Syndicate Of Sentients and the Robotic Regime.  Now the Regimes' Bots control Earth's surface, while the last remaining humans live crammed like sardines in an underwater fallout shelter known as H20ME.  But there is still hope.  A pair of seasoned divers has been recruited for a top secret mission to launch an attack on the Regime HQ. Welcome to Rusted Sea!   

UNLIKELY HEROES

Even though Finn Fontane suffered a devastating injury while working for the Rusted Sea Trading Co. - providing logistics support during The Missile War - she hasn't let that slow her down.  She utilizes her unique persuasive "FINNFLUENCE" ability - which allows her to take control of other sea creatures and use their special abilities to solve puzzles and overcome obstacles.  She is also a valuable wingwoman equipped with a state of the art Pulsating Underwater Laser System (PULS) gadget that makes her an invaluable soldier in the war against the Bots.

What he lacks in brains, he makes up for with excessively overpowered weapons.  Armed with an entertaining and destructive arsenal, war vet Cade Callahan provides combat support to his wingwoman Finn. His TORPEDITO mini-torpedo launcher is especially useful for the 'effishent' eradication of large swarms of SeaBots.  He also is equipped with more utilitarian tools like his Underwater-Welder and handy Harpoon Gun.  

STEALTHY SUBMARINES

Finn's personal submarine, - SEA MINOR - comes in super handy with it's powerful robotic CAPO CLAW - which is particularly useful for collecting valuable NUKELIUM NUGGETS that are found scattered across mineral seabed cliffs.  While she lacks in size, SEA MINOR makes up for in utility as an essential vessel for objectives requiring stealth and agility. 

SEAHORSE PLAY

While their mission to save humanity from utter extinction at the hands of the merciless Robotic Regime is important, so is having a little fun - and there is no shortage of whimsical waves splashing throughout Rusted Sea.  So what are you waiting for? Dive right in!

short_description: Earth's surface has been entirely irradiated by nuclear fallout from The War and Regime Robots have taken control. A small colony of humans fight for their lives underwater. The survival of our species rests on an unlikely pair of Vets who have been recruited for one last mission: Rusted Sea.
